column1: # W-FLAG — entry points, flag table, diagnostics, IL bundle I/O.

column4: export _InvokeCompilerPassW@16; latches *param_4 as in/out status, calls 0x10b7f3e7
export DllGetObjHandler; two 16-byte ID compares, COM HRESULTs, operator new(0x20)
guard called first by both Invoke entries; nonzero return skips the pass
p2 main: argv latch, phase sequence; returns *0x10c2ea8c
tokenises MSC_CMD_FLAGS through the same matcher
option driver: memset(0x10c40220,0,0xce0), match loop, C1007 at 0x10b84a95, options fold
4250-byte store sequence building the 148-record array at 0x10c46bd8; ret at 0x10c2a3b5
matcher: 12-byte stride, terminator on byte +9, '-'/'#'/'*' rules, returns byte +8
wildcard compare, reached only from the '*' pattern branch
wide string -> long, used by kind 0x24 and the 0x23 sub-table
diagnostic number = code + 1000 (lea ecx,[esi+0x3e8]); selects severity
Fatal with path + __wcserror_s text; both C1083 sites call it
non-LTCG bundle reader: gl (mapped), then in, ex, sy; hosts the emit walk loop
LTCG bundle reader: gl, in, ex, sy, then db when -Zi or -typedil
